text:
When powdered sodium carbonate and aqueous ethanoic acid are mixed, the temperature of the
mixture falls.
Which statement about this reaction is correct?
A
The reaction is endothermic and ∆H is negative.
B
The reaction is endothermic and ∆H is positive.
The reaction is exothermic and ΔH is negative.
C
D
The reaction is exothermic and ∆H is positive.

options.label: A
options.text: The reaction is endothermic and ∆H is negative.

options.label: B
options.text: The reaction is endothermic and ∆H is positive.

options.label: C
options.text: The reaction is exothermic and ΔH is negative.

options.label: D
options.text: The reaction is exothermic and ∆H is positive.
